description: Google News search via Serper: returns recent news articles (title, link, snippet, source, date) matching the query. Accepts query, result count (max 20), and optional country code (gl).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

query.description: Search query, e.g. "federal reserve rate decision"

name: news
